context_diary: The account_lookup function retrieves user data by type with optional filters and field selection. It supports pagination through limit parameters but doesn't have a built-in random sampling feature—random selection must be done post-query. Currency filtering appears to work by matching exact string values in the database. The system contains agents with multiple currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, TRY) and returns results in JSON format with MongoDB-style date objects. When querying large datasets, the system caps results at 20 records by default with a total match count provided.
